faqs.a: Only people who agreed to hear from your practice. If we are not sure a patient agreed, we do not text them.

faqs.q: What if a patient does not want the texts?
faqs.a: A patient can reply STOP and the texts stop.

faqs.q: What do you do with patient details?
faqs.a: We never sell or share them, and we keep only what we need to send one text.

faqs.q: Is written consent needed in every state?
faqs.a: We do not know yet. It needs a lawyer or a practice that knows the rules. We will not guess, and we will not text a patient unless we are sure they agreed.
Yes, whenever you want. It is month to month with no contract.
